Did you speak to the manager?
Good evening. My bag is missing. It did not come off the plane.
I am sorry. Which flight did you take?
Flight 214 from Chicago. I waited at the belt for forty minutes.
Did you check the bag in Chicago or in Sao Paulo?
In Sao Paulo. Nobody told me anything in Chicago.
Please fill out this form with your address and your hotel.
Here you are. I have a meeting tomorrow and all my clothes were in that bag.
I found it. It stayed in Chicago and it arrives at six in the morning.
And tonight? Do I get a voucher for what I need to buy?
Yes, one hundred dollars. Keep the receipts, because your insurance may pay the rest.
Thank you. Where do I file a complaint if it does not arrive?
My bag is missing. It did not come off the plane.
Where is the lost and found office?
I booked and paid for this room in October.
I would like a full refund, please.

Attention passengers of flight 214 from Chicago. Some bags did not travel with the aircraft this evening. If your bag is missing, please go to the lost and found office on the arrivals level and fill out a delayed baggage form. You will receive a reference number. We delivered every delayed bag from yesterday within twenty-four hours, and we expect the same tonight. If you paid for travel insurance, keep your receipts, because the airline does not refund what the insurance already covers.

Good evening, this is Daniel, the duty manager at the Riverside Hotel. I am calling about your reservation for tonight. Unfortunately the hotel was overbooked and we could not keep your room. We booked you a room at our sister hotel, four blocks away, and we paid for the taxi. You will also receive a voucher for dinner and a full refund of tonight's rate. I am very sorry. If this is a problem, please call me back and I will find another solution.

First, Thiago waited at the belt but his bag never arrived. Then he went to the lost and found office. After that, he filled out a form and gave the agent his address. Next, she said the bag was in Chicago and promised it for the morning. Finally, the airline sent him a voucher and a full refund.
